completion:
Okay, here's a comprehensive set of instructions for accurately documenting failed brake tests in a vehicle inspection report, building from your starting point of "Start with the inspection records."  I've broken it down into sections for clarity.  This is detailed; thoroughness is *critical* with brake failures.

**I. Preparation & Initial Records (Building on "Start with the inspection records")**

1. **Start with the Inspection Records:** Document the vehicle's identification (VIN, make, model, year) *exactly* as it appears on the vehicle and registration.  Record the date and time of the inspection. Note the odometer reading.  This establishes a clear chain of custody and traceability.
2. **Review Vehicle History (If Available):** Briefly note any relevant prior brake service history.  Was there recent work done?  If so, what? This can point to potential issues or misdiagnosis.  Don't
